name: pylon_nr_pylon_chance_pct

name: pylon_gr_base_chance_pct

name: pylon_gr_full_chance_progress_pct

name: pylon_gr_check_yards

name: pylon_gr_max_per_run

name: pylon_gr_check_ms

name: pylon_min_spacing_yd
